description: This file contains PHP source code defining test classes for the HTML Table of Contents feature, using PHPUnit framework. It includes a mock Engine, a Template class, and a comprehensive test suite for verifying TOC rendering behavior.

classes.name: Engine
classes.description: A mock engine class that simulates rendering by returning content directly from data array.

classes.name: Template
classes.description: A template class extending the base Template, providing a method to get an Engine instance.

classes.name: TableOfContentsTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class containing multiple tests for verifying the behavior of TOC generation in Markdown conversion.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the template with provided data, returning the 'content' element.

methods.name: getEngine
methods.description: Returns a new Engine instance for the provided configuration.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Sets up and returns a configuration array with a custom Template renderer.

methods.name: testNoTOCByDefault
methods.description: Verifies that no TOC is added by default in the Markdown conversion.

methods.name: testShouldAddTOCWhenAutoTOCisOn
methods.description: Checks that a TOC is added when auto_toc is enabled.

methods.name: testShouldNotAddTOCWhenAutoTOCisOnAndTOCisPresent
methods.description: Ensures TOC is not added again if a TOC is present inline.

methods.name: testTOCToken
methods.description: Tests behavior when [TOC] token is used.

methods.name: testUnicodeTOC
methods.description: Verifies correct TOC generation with Unicode headings.

methods.name: testDuplicatedTOC
methods.description: Checks handling of multiple headings with same text.

methods.name: testEscapedTOC
methods.description: Checks correct handling of special characters in headings.

methods.name: testQuotesWorkCorrectly
methods.description: Verifies special character escaping, with a note on PHP version requirement.
